title: Meteorite that landed in Cape Cod was a 'lone wolf' from the outer solar system, scientists find
caption:
A bright fireball over Cape Cod in 2026 was actually a lone asteroid. By combining multiple radar and sensor networks, researchers traced the rock's journey from the asteroid belt to our atmosphere.

Source: Space - Meteorite that landed in Cape Cod was a 'lone wolf' from the outer solar system, scientists find
